settings.text: Refills: 3 pods for $21, and we tell you when
One pod treats a living room about 25 times, so most households need three about every two months. We work that out from the day you bought and email you before you run out. One click, done.
Nothing recurring, nothing on file, nothing charged without you asking for it. If the reminder is early, ignore it. We will send the next one.
And no, the gun isn't locked to our pods. It takes any water-based enzyme solution you like. We sell refills because ours are pre-dosed, not because you're stuck with them.
Refills are always one-time. No subscription to cancel.
